claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the LG logo on the top left corner.

claims.claim: The washing machine does not work.
claims.evidence: The report does not show the machine operating; whether it powers on is not shown.
Static photos cannot confirm repair needs; operation is not shown.
Scrap status is an economic and condition judgment not visible in the report.

risks.risk: Whether the machine powers on and operates correctly.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine powering on, filling, agitating or spinning, and draining.

risks.risk: Condition of water inlet and drain hoses.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both hoses showing no cracks, leaks, or blockages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as hoses damaged or missing.

risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate or serial number, or the original purchase receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an older, out-of-warranty unit.

risks.risk: Availability of original manuals or packaging.
risks.proof: Photo of the manuals and original box.
Photo of the warranty card or a screenshot of LG warranty verification.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and completing a wash or spin cycle.
Close-up photos of the water inlet and drain hoses.
Photo of the rating plate or serial number.
Photo of original manuals and packaging if available.
Warranty card or proof of warranty status.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an LG front-load washing machine with a readable model, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's non-working claim is unverified but sets the floor.
